class Account {
    final String id;
    final String? nickname;
    final String? note;
    final Status status;

    Account({
        required this.id,
        this.nickname,
        this.note,
        required this.status,
    });

    factory Account.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
        return Account(
            id: json["id"] as String,
            nickname: json["nickname"] as String?,
            note: json["note"] as String?,
            status: Status.fromValue(json["status"] as String),
        );
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
        return {
            "id": id,
            "nickname": nickname,
            "note": note,
            "status": status.value,
        };
    }
}

enum Status {
    active("active"),
    inactive("inactive"),
    pending("pending");

    final String value;
    const Status(this.value);

    static Status fromValue(String value) => Status.values.firstWhere((e) => e.value == value);
}
